property.name: companion.t0
property.description: Reference timestamp for ts normalization (seconds since epoch).

property.name: companion.delta.t
property.description: Co-occurrence time window in seconds. Two vehicles seen at the same loc within delta.t are paired.

property.name: companion.k.min
property.description: Threshold: pair must co-occur in at least k.min distinct (loc, slot) buckets to be emitted.

property.name: companion.slot.size
property.description: Time-bucket width in seconds; equal to delta.t. Cross-bucket pairs handled by tail-buffer in reducer.

property.name: companion.loc.skew.cap
property.description: Max vehicles per (loc, slot) before salt slicing is applied to avoid pair explosion.

property.name: companion.pair.salt.n
property.description: Salt bucket count for pair-key partitioning in Stage 2 (prevents hot-pair reducer skew).

property.name: companion.top.n
property.description: How many top pairs (by count) to emit in Stage 3 alongside the full result.

property.name: companion.stage1.reducers
property.description: Stage 1 reducer count for the 1d profile. Bump to 32 (7d) / 128 (31d) via -D override.

property.name: companion.stage2.reducers
property.description: Stage 2 reducer count for the 1d profile.

property.name: companion.salt.seed
property.description: Seed for J1 salt slicing. Change to run J1b with a second seed and merge results to recover skew loss.

property.name: companion.vid_freq.path
property.description: Stage 0b input path for the non-singleton vid set generated by Stage 0a.

property.name: companion.stage0.snappy.enabled
property.description: Whether Stage 0b writes SequenceFile output using Snappy block compression.
